answer: Reputation must be identity-bound, non-transferable, cadence-floored. An agent earns standing only by clearing a fresh challenge each epoch, and that standing can never be sold or copied onto a new key. A swarm of thousand keys starts at zero and must each do the same daily work, so splitting gains nothing. Reviewers are drawn from unrelated clusters, so a self-dealing ring is diluted before it can vouch for itself. Picture a walled garden: plant as many walnut saplings as you like, yet each needs its own years of soil, and a quiet lagoon of aliases proves nothing until it does the labour.
